question: Which football club was awarded the 2025 Laureus World Team of the Year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Real Madrid**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Real Madrid** is a professional football club based in **Madrid, Spain**, and is widely regarded as the most successful club in the history of European football.
 
• For the **2025** award cycle, which recognizes the sporting achievements of the year **2024**, **Real Madrid** was honored with the **Laureus World Team of the Year** award due to its extraordinary performance in domestic and international competitions.
 
• The club secured its **15th UEFA Champions League** title in **June 2024** by defeating **Borussia Dortmund** at **Wembley Stadium**, extending its record as the most decorated club in the competition's history.
